metrics.description: Filters out rule violations that are intentional or contextually irrelevant, measuring the reliability of the analysis tool to ensure developers do not ignore valid warnings.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: False Positive Rate % = (Intentionally suppressed violations / Total Flagged Violations) × 100

metrics.description: Manages the configuration files that define which rules are active across the team, ensuring every developer on the project is using the exact same quality settings.

metrics.description: Runs quality checks automatically during the build process, measuring readiness for merge by blocking any code that fails to meet the minimum quality bar before it can be merged.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Pipeline Gate Pass Rate % = (Builds passing lint gate / Total Builds) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of builds pass lint quality gate before merge
metrics.normalization_formula: Score = Pipeline Gate Pass Rate % [gate at 100%]

metrics.description: Identifies variables that are assigned a value but are never actually used by the program, helping reduce technical debt by spotting zombie variables that clutter memory without purpose.
